entries.title: Psalms 44:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. For the sons of Korah, a contemplation. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work which You did in their days, in the days of old.

entries.title: Psalms 44:2
segments: You drove out the nations [with] Your hand, and planted them; You brought evil on peoples and cast them out.

entries.title: Psalms 44:3
segments: For they did not get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but [it was] Your right hand, and Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.

entries.title: Psalms 44:4
segments: You [are] my king, O God; command victories for Jacob.

entries.title: Psalms 44:5
segments: Through You we will push our enemies; through Your name we will trample those who rise up against us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:6
segments: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

entries.title: Psalms 44:7
segments: But You have saved us from our enemies, and have put them to shame, those who hated us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:8
segments: In God we boast all the day long, and praise Your name forever. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 44:9
segments: Now You have cast us off, and have shamed us, and You do not go forth with our armies.

entries.title: Psalms 44:10
segments: You make us turn back from the adversary; and our haters plunder for themselves.

entries.title: Psalms 44:11
segments: You have given us like sheep [for] food, and have scattered us among the nations.

entries.title: Psalms 44:12
segments: You have sold Your people for nothing, and You did not increase by their price.

entries.title: Psalms 44:13
segments: You make us a curse to our neighbors, a scorn and a mockery to those who are round about us.

entries.title: Psalms 44:14
segments: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 44:15
segments: My shame [is] always before me, and the shame of my face has covered me:

entries.title: Psalms 44:16
segments: because of the voice of the slanderer and the blasphemer; before the enemy and avenger.

entries.title: Psalms 44:17
segments: All this has come on us; yet we have not forgotten You nor dealt falsely in Your covenant.

entries.title: Psalms 44:18
segments: Our heart is not turned back, nor have our steps turned aside from Your way,

entries.title: Psalms 44:19
segments: though You have crushed us in the place of jackals and covered us with the shadow of death.

entries.title: Psalms 44:20
segments: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god,

entries.title: Psalms 44:21
segments: shall not God search this out? For He knows the secrets of the heart.

entries.title: Psalms 44:22
segments: Yea, for Your sake we are put to death all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

entries.title: Psalms 44:23
segments: Awaken! Why do You sleep, O LORD? Arise! Do not cast [us] off forever.

entries.title: Psalms 44:24
segments: Why do You hide Your face, [and] forget our affliction and distress?

entries.title: Psalms 44:25
segments: For our soul is bowed down to the dust; our belly holds fast to the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 44:26
segments: Arise [for] our help, and redeem us for the sake of Your mercy.
